_comment: Specs known to fail because they need external configuration, a feature that ships off, or an UNRESOLVED environment problem on the dev machine. NOT a list of acceptable bugs. Every entry must carry a reason in _reasons below, and the list should only ever shrink. Regenerate with bin/check-journey-run.sh --update and say why in the commit message.
known_failing: profile/hero-actions.spec.ts::J-743 Share → Share to feed creates a post referencing the profile

_reasons._recovered_2026-09-01: The five card-10211458045 specs (J-550 announcement-dismiss, J-513 announcement, J-510 audience-picker, J-504 reactors, J-720 profile-tabs) were REMOVED from the baseline: they all pass now. Their original 'first-navigation timeout' cause was the hard-coded dev host in playwright.config.ts (fixed: the base URL resolves from the tester's Local site). J-513/J-510 then surfaced a second, harness-only cause - the specs resolved the non-owner member and the author id from a hard-coded 'varundubey' that does not exist on every site; the gate now exports BN_TEST_OTHER_USER (the seeded subscriber) and audience-picker resolves the author from BN_TEST_USER. J-550 and J-504 also carried real code fixes this release. All five verified passing locally with the gate's env (seeded users, BN_TEST_USER=user 1, BN_TEST_OTHER_USER=alice).
_reasons.profile/hero-actions.spec.ts::J-743 Shar: The feature this covers no longer has an entry point. The profile hero's Share-to-feed link is gone - nothing in includes/, assets/, templates/ or blocks/ builds a ?mention= URL any more - while the RECEIVING half is still live: assets/js/feed/composer.js:449 still reads ?mention= and pre-fills the composer, reachable only by typing the URL by hand. So this is a half-removed feature, not a flaky spec, and it fails identically on the v1.1.6 tag. Baselined rather than rewritten because a rewrite could only assert that nothing happens. Un-baseline when the owner decides: restore an entry point, or delete the orphaned composer handling and retire this journey.
_reasons._fixed_2026-09-13: moderation/queue admin-queue-renders REMOVED from baseline: the queue container (.bn-mod-queue / [data-mod-queue]) renders on the reports tab, but the spec navigated to the bare ?page=buddynext-moderation URL which no longer lands there. Fixed the URL to &tab=reports (selectors.ts). Renders empty or not - no fixture needed.
_reasons._fixed_trending_2026-09-13: explore/trending REMOVED from baseline: (1) the explore page renders trending tags as .bn-ex-trend__tag (discovery deck), not the shared sel.hashtagChip - spec now uses a local selector; (2) bin/seed-e2e.sh seeds two hashtag posts (via PostService + synchronous hashtag index) so a fresh CI site has trending content. Verified 2 passed locally.
